title: SequentDraw workflow document
description: The IR (intermediate representation) SequentDraw renders as a self-contained n8n-style HTML map. Structural rules are enforced here (types, enums, lengths, id shape, the suggested-node-requires-rationale rule, and the fact that a group has no parentId at all). The following rules are cross-references this schema CANNOT express and are enforced instead by validateDoc() in src/n8n/validate.js: (1) every node.parentId, when set, must reference a declared group id; (2) every edge.from and edge.to must reference a declared node id; (3) no node may be orphaned (zero edges) unless it is the only node in its group (nodes sharing the same parentId, including the ungrouped bucket); (4) node.sublabel, when present, must be 3 words or fewer by word count, not just <=60 characters; (5) an edge whose condition is non-null must have type "dashed"; (6) node, group, and note ids share one namespace, so no id may be duplicated within its own array or collide across nodes/groups/notes; (7) note.attachTo entries must reference a declared node or group id; (8) tour[].order values must be unique across the tour array; (9) tour[].nodeIds entries must reference declared node ids; (10) required strings (title, label, content, tour title/description) must be non-empty after trimming whitespace -- this schema's minLength:1 accepts a whitespace-only string that validateDoc() rejects.

$schema.title: Schema reference
$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema file, for editor tooling. Not validated further.

title.title: Map title
title.description: The document title, shown in the HTML page title and the floating title bar. Required, non-empty, at most 120 characters.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: One entry per sub-workflow, drawn as a pastel frame behind its member nodes. Optional; omit or leave empty for an ungrouped map.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Every tool, actor, or artifact in the workflow, drawn as its own 96px icon node. Required. Capped at 100 nodes per map to keep layout readable.

edges.title: Edges
edges.description: Directed connections between nodes: solid (deterministic flow), dashed (conditional, or a return/retry path), or gutter (cross-group link routed in the margin). Required; may be empty only for a single-node document.

notes.title: Sticky notes
notes.description: n8n-style sticky notes carrying Markdown explanations, optionally attached to a node or group. Optional. Capped at 20 notes per map.

tour.title: Tour
tour.description: An ordered list of steps, each spotlighting one or more nodes with a short narration, for walking a reader through the map. Optional; generated on request, not by default.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: 1-64 characters: letters, digits, underscore, period, colon, or hyphen. Referenced by other parts of the document to link nodes, groups, and notes together.

group.title: Group
group.description: A sub-workflow container drawn as a pastel frame. Groups may not nest: this object intentionally has no parentId property, so a group with one present is rejected by additionalProperties:false. See root description item (6) for the shared id namespace this schema cannot check.

id.title: Group id
id.description: Unique identifier for this group, referenced by node.parentId.

label.title: Group label
label.description: Title shown top-left inside the group's frame. Required, non-empty, at most 80 characters.

color.title: Group color
color.description: Frame fill/border color, one swatch from the fixed group palette. Optional; the renderer picks a default when omitted.

node.title: Node
node.description: A tool, actor, or artifact in the workflow. See root description items (1), (3), (4), (6) for cross-reference rules this schema cannot express on its own.

id.title: Node id
id.description: Unique identifier for this node, referenced by edge.from, edge.to, node.parentId (on other nodes it does not apply to itself), note.attachTo, and tour[].nodeIds.

label.title: Node label
label.description: The tool, actor, or artifact name, shown below the node. Required, non-empty, at most 80 characters.

sublabel.title: Sublabel
sublabel.description: What the node does here, shown under the label in smaller type. Optional, at most 60 characters. SPEC also requires 3 words or fewer, which this schema cannot count -- see root description item (4).

kind.title: Node kind
kind.description: The category of thing this node represents, which selects its glyph and border style. Required.

icon.title: Icon slug
icon.description: Resolved simple-icons or Iconify slug for the node's brand icon. Null falls back to the kind glyph; never guess a brand. Optional.

parentId.title: Parent group id
parentId.description: The id of the group this node belongs to, or null/omitted if ungrouped. Must reference a declared group -- see root description item (1), which this schema cannot check.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Which named overlays this node is visible in: base (happy path, always visible), edge (failures/retries/disputes), business (human actors, artifacts, external parties), build (CI/eval/deployment). Optional; a node with no layers behaves as if it were only in "base".

status.title: Node status
status.description: confirmed: established from the input. open: a gap the tool could not establish, rendered with a dotted ring. suggested: proposed by a suggestion agent, rendered distinctly and requiring a rationale. Optional; defaults to confirmed.

source.title: Node source
source.description: Where this node came from: an automated repo scan, a user's answer, or a model's inference/suggestion. Optional.

prompt.title: Gap prompt
prompt.description: The open question shown to the user for a status:"open" node, e.g. why the tool could not resolve it. Optional, at most 500 characters.

rationale.title: Suggestion rationale
rationale.description: Why this node was suggested, tied to something concrete in the user's own design (not a generic best-practice claim). Required and non-empty when status is "suggested"; not allowed on any other node -- see the if/then/else below.

edge.title: Edge
edge.description: A directed connection between two nodes. See root description items (2), (5) for cross-reference rules this schema cannot express on its own.

from.title: Source node id
from.description: The id of the node this edge starts at. Must reference a declared node -- see root description item (2), which this schema cannot check.

to.title: Target node id
to.description: The id of the node this edge ends at. Must reference a declared node -- see root description item (2), which this schema cannot check.

type.title: Edge type
type.description: solid: deterministic flow, always happens. dashed: conditional, or a return/retry path. gutter: cross-group link routed in the margin, never through a container. Required.

condition.title: Condition label
condition.description: The branch condition rendered beside this edge's own handle, e.g. an IF/Switch branch label. Optional; when set to a non-null string, type must be "dashed" (enforced below).

note.title: Sticky note
note.description: A Markdown text box, optionally attached to a node or group. See root description item (7) for a cross-reference rule this schema cannot express on its own.

id.title: Note id
id.description: Unique identifier for this note. Shares an id namespace with nodes and groups -- see root description item (6), which this schema cannot check.

content.title: Note content
content.description: Markdown subset: headings, bold, italic, inline code, bullet lists, line breaks, and http(s)/mailto links. Required, non-empty, at most 2000 characters.

attachTo.title: Attach targets
attachTo.description: Node or group ids this note is placed beside. Omit, or leave empty, for a map-level note pinned at the top-left. Each entry must reference a declared node or group -- see root description item (7), which this schema cannot check.

color.title: Note color
color.description: One of the seven sticky-note swatches. Optional; defaults to yellow.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Same visibility rule as node.layers: the note is shown when any of these overlays is active. Optional; defaults to base.

tourEntry.title: Tour step
tourEntry.description: One step of a tour: a spotlight over one or more nodes with a short narration. See root description items (8), (9) for cross-reference rules this schema cannot express on its own.

order.title: Step order
order.description: This step's 1-based position in the tour. Must be a positive integer, and unique across the whole tour array -- uniqueness is a cross-reference rule this schema cannot check, see root description item (8).

title.title: Step title
title.description: Short heading for this tour step. Required, non-empty, at most 80 characters.

description.title: Step narration
description.description: The narration shown for this step. Required, non-empty, at most 500 characters.

nodeIds.title: Spotlighted node ids
nodeIds.description: The nodes this step spotlights; everything else is dimmed. Required, non-empty. Each entry must reference a declared node -- see root description item (9), which this schema cannot check.
